title: Enshrouded
description: Enshrouded dedicated server (Steam app 2278520) - one UDP port. Before the first start ServerDeck writes enshrouded_server.json with passwords for the Admin and Friend groups; leave the Guest password empty and anyone can join as a guest (explore and dig, but no bases or chests). Edit everything else under Configs. Enshrouded has no RCON, so players can't be warned before a restart (updates wait until nobody is on) and ServerDeck sees only the names of who is on (Steam query) - kicks, bans and admin rights come with the group passwords in game. Stops use Ctrl+C, which saves the world.

fields.label: Server name (in the server list)
fields.help: written to enshrouded_server.json on the first start - change it there later

fields.label: Admin password
fields.help: join with it to kick/ban and change anything; left empty, a random one is made

fields.label: Friend password
fields.help: join with it to build in bases and open chests; left empty, a random one is made

fields.label: Guest password
fields.help: optional - left empty, anyone can join as a guest

player_notes.ban: Enshrouded can't ban from here: an admin bans in game (its list holds hashed accounts, not Steam IDs).
player_notes.roles: Roles come with the server's passwords: the Admin, Friend and Guest group passwords.
